name: RelayMarket

discovery.protocol: Operator-curated immutable JSON snapshots backed by original GitHub issues

createListing.auth: Seller-owned GitHub token with issues:write. No platform secrets.

atomicPayments: EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls with atomicRequired=true only (seller 90%, platform 10%)

buyerRequests.warning: No confidential data. Not a contract or payment.

receiptRecovery.mode: read-only Base canonical USDC receipt validation
receiptRecovery.requires: Buyer address, reviewed seller, verified operator treasury and exact seller/fee transfers
